scope: Known defects and evidence gaps in the approved data/GPU remediation; not certification of every training path.

issues.affected_scope: Three source-qualified named-risk profiles; not all CT=F experiments.
issues.remediation: Preserve old results with source qualifications; require verified replacement cells and lifecycle evidence before new fits.
issues.closure: Complete source-bound repair and downstream dependency acceptance; recounting the defect is not repair.

issues.problem: Partial source tables inferred contract absence from month/rank.
issues.affected_scope: Readiness computation and its independent verifier.
issues.remediation: Missing quotes in partial tables remain UNKNOWN. Strict real-source replay and independent computation agree.
issues.closure: Code defect fixed; this does not close DG-001 or DG-004.

issues.problem: Missing source tables defaulted to complete and implied absence.
issues.remediation: Default completeness is false; uncertainty propagates through EWMA without hidden state reset.
issues.closure: Strict conditional scope has zero fully ready origins; no new market campaign admitted.

issues.problem: Full source/lifecycle/first-publication/vintage evidence is not available for every required dependency.
issues.affected_scope: Named-risk G1; actual price errors are not equivalent to potential unknown cells.
issues.remediation: G1 stays closed. Official Rule10.07 default schedule is now a hash-bound conditional diagnostic (83,312pre-month/1,216in-month/14,995post-month unknown cells), not actual historical absence admission. The user reports sending the58-contract lifecycle/exception/sample/quote inquiry. Actual sent content, delivery and reply are not independently verified; no source has been admitted. Updated user plan reports helpdesk routing to data@ice.com; no direct data evidence accepted and no message sent by assistant.
issues.closure: All required cells accepted, or separately preregistered narrower universe; current catalog limits do not prove global absence.

issues.problem: Direct QLIKE-HAR optimizer could fit without a data-admission scope.
issues.affected_scope: volatility.qlike_har direct entrypoint and nested adapter calls.
issues.remediation: Require runtime permission and exact admitted training frame, horizon and ordered features before preprocessing or optimization.
issues.closure: Valid generated fit passes; absent/expired authority, changed labels/split/horizon/features stop before minimize.

issues.problem: Admission and temporal tests do not yet prove every preprocessing, selection and prediction path is protected.
issues.affected_scope: Full G2; feature-level causality is narrower than prediction/selection invariance.
issues.remediation: The fixed price-only T+1 cohort has independent exact-origin/target/value checks, Decimal loss/gate checks, active metrics and fresh native/preprocessing replay. All338fixed Ridge/Quantile native states pass first/last-test-origin prefix and future-price perturbation checks, including frozen outer weights. Fresh archive replay is byte-identical with network/training disabled. This does not prove how all selections were made; remaining selection-policy and other dataset/model contracts still need coverage.
issues.closure: Requirement-by-requirement G2 coverage including independent common-origin evaluation and native prediction replay.

issues.problem: L4 save/load and optimizer replay do not establish forced-session interruption, OOM or duplicate-worker handling.
issues.affected_scope: Fixed single-worker L4 synthetic worker/session restart, explicit PCG64/Philox mask continuation and bounded allocator OOM; not universal G3 or market-model certification.
issues.remediation: User-returned L4 save/load, worker-exit/resume, bounded128MiB allocator-OOM/fresh-process recovery, and distinct-boot session/explicit RNG receipts passed independent hash/native checks. Session native reference/resume error is0; NumPy checks both Adam updates and predictions within1e-6. Prior receipts are preserved without rerunning probes. Ledger duplicate/attempt controls remain separately verified.
issues.closure: Scoped fault evidence is complete: actual returned session/RNG result and10-file fresh private Release restore reproduce offline verification with training imports blocked and0new fits. Boot/marker/hardware are reported witnesses, not remote attestation. Physical VRAM saturation, arbitrary Keras dropout/tf.data RNG, multi-GPU, other architectures, performance campaigns and G1/G2 admission are outside this closure.

issues.problem: Legacy LSTM positive comparison used unequal periods; missing predictions prevent a complete paired inference.
issues.affected_scope: Legacy comparison; not evidence that all engines fail.
issues.remediation: Retract unequal-period advantage and preserve incomplete evidence; do not fill historical gaps by retraining.
issues.closure: Historical paired claim remains unavailable unless original required predictions are recovered.

issues.problem: Inner model-selection loops trusted supplied fold metadata without rechecking the frozen temporal boundaries at execution. No historical leakage occurrence is inferred from the missing guard.
issues.affected_scope: Experiment.inner, Experiment.tune and full_year.inner_price; fixed three-by-63 protocol.
issues.remediation: Reject outer-origin substitution, late or unknown T+1/T+5 maturity, duplicate/reordered/overlapping origins, missing blocks/rows, compressed recorded source observations and cutoff mismatch before fits.
issues.closure: Positive controls and injected defects exercised all three entrypoints; actual eight-year price split passed zero-fit replay. Vendor availability and other selection procedures remain outside this proof.

issues.problem: Direct concurrent Ledger.run calls relied on caller ownership, and an abrupt process exit could leave no durable attempt-start record.
issues.affected_scope: Research Ledger.run execution, staging/upload retry and summary metadata; existing completed records remain readable.
issues.remediation: Serialize direct ledger execution with visible non-stealable ownership; record run_id before computation and after verified staging; correlate caught failures with the run. Unresolved starts are counted separately from completed fits.
issues.closure: Actual competing process rejected, hard-exit attempt/partial preserved, explicit verified-owner test recovery starts a distinct run; completed cache is reused and corrupted staging never retrains. This does not close native GPU G3.

issues.problem: Readiness treated complete ten-quote reports and conditional annual tables as proof of absence for all other contracts. Report completeness is not exchange listing completeness.
issues.affected_scope: Main readiness quote lookup and independently constructed verification pool; historical listings themselves remain unverified.
issues.remediation: Only separate verified absence coverage can establish ABSENT; existing report constructors do not supply it. Current primary ICE expiry table has 15contracts but is not backdated to the historical universe.
issues.closure: Regression tests reject absence from a full ten-quote report. Zero-fit real-source rerun and independent verifier agree on99,523potential cells,0fully ready origins. Fresh restore reproduces eight outputs byte-identically. Lifecycle/PIT evidence gaps are not closed.

issues.problem: The independent price verifier checked equal arm cohorts but did not bind every exported origin and target to the frozen split/history.
issues.affected_scope: research.verify_naive_mae for fixed price-only median T+1; no actual wrong export was found.
issues.remediation: Validate exact frozen cohort/targets, chronology, year/horizon, finite values, active rates and every annual gain; retain independent Decimal/bootstrap implementation.
issues.closure: Both-arm injected defects fail, clean controls pass, original2006-origin exports pass, and fresh native342fit replay has zero difference without training. Scope does not prove vendor availability or other model families.

issues.problem: Direct TextPreprocessor.fit could learn TF-IDF vocabulary/IDF and SVD without data admission; future-target feature validation occurred only after SVD. No historical leakage occurrence is inferred.
issues.affected_scope: Direct text preprocessing and nested fixed Ridge T+5 text adapter; no production artifact schema change.
issues.remediation: Require exact dispatched training frame, ordered features and text config before learning; reject future-target features before vocabulary/SVD. Preserve no-fit deserialization and explicitly admitted synthetic controls.
issues.closure: Regression failed before fix at vocabulary learning; 11new controls and existing generated text/model admission checks pass. Source truth and full G2 remain separate open requirements.

issues.problem: Engine tune/outer reused self-hashed records by path without binding current candidates, selected members/weights or actual source frames. No historical occurrence is inferred.
issues.affected_scope: Experiment.tune and Experiment.outer, including inherited transfer panel context and nested ensembles.
issues.remediation: Bind exact request, fold, identity and bounded history/panel frames; reject missing/changed bindings before callbacks. Preserve historical read_record/frozen-source inspection and never silently retrain.
issues.closure: Generated valid/reuse and injected-fault controls pass in covered entrypoints. Other custom selection/cache paths and full G2 remain open.

issues.problem: Ensemble weights required common OOF origins but did not require the exact frozen three-by-63 inner cohort or recheck its maturity. No historical occurrence is inferred.
issues.affected_scope: free_rounds.ensemble_fold shared OOF cohort before member predictions and weight optimization.
issues.remediation: Validate temporal fold and exact ordered189inner origins for every seed before prediction/optimization; reject outer labels, missing origins and immature labels.
issues.closure: Generated valid/reuse and injected-fault controls pass in covered entrypoints. Other custom selection/cache paths and full G2 remain open.

issues.problem: Adaptive completed decisions and partial journals could be replayed without binding the current actual source/fold/features/budget and Optuna version. No historical leakage occurrence is inferred.
issues.affected_scope: adaptive.tune decisions, shared trial journal, per-namespace attempt, exact proposal/result binding and stopped extensions.
issues.remediation: Revalidate exact context on creation, resume and consumption; reject altered/unbound records without deleting old evidence or automatically retraining.
